description: 水杉输入法 - 开源的 Windows TSF 输入法 (Metasequoia IME)。安装包为全局安装，程序文件写入 C:\Program Files\metasequoiaime，需要管理员权限

script: if (-not (is_admin)) { error 'Administrator privileges are required to install the IME (TSF DLL must be registered in System32/SysWOW64).'; break }
# scoop update also runs the uninstaller hook, but it must not uninstall: the new setup.exe upgrades in place, and the Inno uninstaller deletes the whole data dir.
# If the call-stack check ever stops matching, this becomes a no-op (manual cleanup), which is safer than deleting user data.

notes: This is a global install: program files go to C:\Program Files\metasequoiaime; Scoop only keeps the installer.
Upgrades run the official setup.exe in place (no uninstall), which preserves config.toml, user dictionaries and skins.
'scoop uninstall msime' runs the Inno uninstaller automatically. If it does not, run C:\Program Files\metasequoiaime\unins000.exe manually.
